parameters.content:
## Monitor Telegram Channels for Market Intelligence

Turn public Telegram channel posts into a focused intelligence feed with fetch_cat/telegram-channel-posts-scraper, OpenAI, Google Sheets, and Telegram. The workflow works on n8n Cloud or self-hosted n8n and makes one structured AI call per non-empty batch.

### How it works

1. Starts manually or once every hour and creates its delivery ledger if needed.
2. Reads public channel handles, an intelligence goal, relevance threshold, and item limits from one editable Set node.
3. Runs the Apify Actor once, normalizes the newest posts, and removes IDs already delivered.
4. Classifies all unseen posts in one strict OpenAI batch.
5. Saves relevant posts to Google Sheets and sends at most five in one Telegram digest.
6. Records evaluated IDs only after required destinations succeed, so delivery failures remain retryable.

### Setup

- [ ] Enter public channel handles and describe the business questions that matter.
- [ ] Connect Apify HTTP Header Auth in both request nodes.
- [ ] Connect OpenAI and keep the pinned low-cost model.
- [ ] Copy the spreadsheet template and select its Telegram Intelligence tab.
- [ ] Create a Telegram bot with BotFather, connect it, and enter the destination chat ID.
- [ ] Run manually twice to verify delivery and deduplication before publishing the hourly schedule.

The workflow monitors public content only. It never joins channels, contacts authors, or sends automated replies.

## Start and prepare state

Run manually or hourly and create the durable delivery ledger idempotently before collecting posts.

## Configure intelligence

Enter public channel handles, the intelligence goal, score threshold, post limits, and digest limit in one editable node.

## Collect public posts

Run the Telegram Channel Posts Scraper once and download the bounded public dataset after the Actor finishes.

## Normalize and deduplicate

Create stable post keys and readable metrics, remove previously delivered IDs, and assemble one bounded analysis batch.

## Analyze and validate

Use one structured OpenAI call, require exactly one result per input post, and keep only posts meeting the configured relevance threshold.

## Deliver relevant intelligence

Upsert qualified posts to Google Sheets and send one concise Telegram digest with direct links, scores, summaries, and business implications.

## Commit delivery state

Record every evaluated key only after required delivery succeeds, then return a concise execution summary. Failed deliveries remain retryable.
